lead.headline: Towson rates highest, and UNCW and Charleston haven't lost
lead.deck: Two CAA teams sit in our national top 100. The league is already 3-2 against the Ivy.
body: Hardwood Bricks now covers the Coastal Athletic Association, 13 schools from Boston and Long Island down to Wilmington and Charleston. Every game gets a preview, a recap, a line history and a spot in our ratings.
Towson rates highest in the league at 89th despite a 3-2 start. Both losses came out West, at Santa Clara and Utah, and the Tigers have won three straight at home by 20, 30 and 26.
UNC Wilmington (94th) is 4-0. The Seahawks won 78-75 at East Carolina as 5.5-point favorites, then beat Kent State 91-73.
Charleston (125th) is 3-0 and won 91-81 at Temple as a 1.5-point favorite.
The CAA is 3-2 against the Ivy League. Northeastern beat Harvard in overtime and Yale, Elon won at Columbia, and Princeton beat Hofstra and Stony Brook.

column.label: By the Numbers
column.title: Three numbers from the first two weeks
body: **2.** CAA teams in our national top 100, Towson and UNC Wilmington.
**104.** William & Mary's points against Norfolk State, the league's high against a Division I opponent.
**0.** Losses for UNC Wilmington and Charleston, the league's two unbeaten teams.

notes.headline: Hofstra's escape
notes.body: The Pride beat Iona 62-59 in overtime on Friday, a week after losing 60-58 at Princeton.

notes.headline: NC A&T in Athens
notes.body: The Aggies lost 80-70 at Ohio as 15.5-point underdogs, then 72-67 at East Carolina.

notes.headline: Campbell's first win
notes.body: The Camels beat South Carolina Upstate 93-77 on Saturday after three road losses.

notes.headline: Monmouth on the road
notes.body: The Hawks won 74-70 at Quinnipiac after losses to St. John's and Rhode Island.
